look.why: A cool mountain-stream teal that contrasts cleanly with the warm dark umber mottled skin.

size.measure: total length 1.0–1.5 m (second-largest amphibian in the world)

habitat.text: Cold, fast-flowing mountain streams and clear rivers in southwestern Honshu, Shikoku, and Kyushu in Japan.

diet.text: Fish, frogs, crabs, crayfish, and aquatic insects ambushed at night.

facts.text: Breathes entirely through its wrinkled, folded skin rather than lungs, absorbing oxygen directly from cold stream water.
Known in Japan as osanshouo ('giant pepper fish') because its defensive skin secretion smells like Japanese pepper.

id.diet: Ikan, katak, kepiting, udang karang, dan serangga air yang disergap pada malam hari.
facts: Bernapas sepenuhnya melalui kulitnya yang berlipat-lipat, menyerap oksigen langsung dari air sungai yang dingin.
Dijuluki osanshouo ('ikan merica raksasa') di Jepang karena cairan kulitnya beraroma seperti merica Jepang.
